product_overview: OptiAI is an AI-powered desktop system optimization application designed to scan and analyze filesystems, provide AI-driven cleanup and optimization suggestions, and safely execute system maintenance actions with undo capabilities. The product integrates frontend React and Tailwind UI with a Python FastAPI backend and Rust-based Tauri desktop wrapper to provide a seamless user experience across platforms.
core_goals: Provide comprehensive filesystem scanning with duplicate detection, large file identification, and optimization recommendations.
Utilize local LLM AI integration to generate contextual and safe optimization suggestions for system improvement.
Enable secure, encrypted storage of sensitive data with AES-256-GCM password protected vault.
Offer real-time monitoring and management of system processes and startup programs, with a focus on Windows compatibility.
Enforce a robust security policy system to validate all file operations and prevent unwanted or dangerous modifications.
Support discovery and easy installation of new optimization and utility tools from GitHub repositories.
Enable undo functionality for all system optimization actions to allow safe rollback of changes.
key_features: Dashboard presenting real-time system metrics, scan results, and disk usage visualizations.
Advanced filesystem scanner with duplicate file detection, large file alerts, and actionable optimization suggestions.
AI Assistant powered by local LLM (via Ollama) that generates policies-validated optimization plans and tool recommendations.
Secure Vault feature for encrypted password-protected data storage using Argon2id and AES-256-GCM.
Process and startup management modules to monitor and control running processes and configure Windows startup programs.
Safe Action Engine that executes file system changes according to policy, with backup, quarantining, and undo capabilities.
Tool discovery tab with AI-powered GitHub repo recommendations and one-click installation automation.
Comprehensive error handling and validation layers including JSON schema validation and policy enforcement.
Tauri desktop integration providing native system access and a responsive UI built with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion animations.
user_flow_summary: User launches the OptiAI desktop app and lands on the Dashboard showing system metrics and recent scan summaries.
User initiates a filesystem scan using the ScanPanel, which performs multithreaded analysis and returns detailed file info including duplicates.
The AI Assistant analyzes scan results and generates a prioritized optimization action plan with risk badges for user review.
User reviews AI suggestions, explores alternative tools via the Discover tab, and installs desired utilities seamlessly.
User executes approved optimization actions, which are validated against security policies and then safely applied with undo journaling.
User can view and undo previously executed actions from the ActionHistory panel as needed.
User secures sensitive information within the Vault area, using password protection and encryption.
User manages processes and startup tasks from dedicated modules, improving system performance and boot times.
validation_criteria: All scan results and optimization plans must pass strict JSON schema validation before use.
All executed actions require policy.yaml whitelist validation with constraints on batch sizes, protected paths, and high-risk confirmations.
LLM-generated AI suggestions must be sanitized and validated against policy rules to prevent unsafe operations.
System actions execute exclusively using Python standard libraries with no shell command invocations.
Quarantine feature works as expected with deleted files retained for 7 days before permanent removal.
Process and startup management functions operate correctly on supported platforms, especially Windows registry modifications.
Encrypted Vault data must be protected by AES-256-GCM and use secure key derivation with Argon2id.
UI components operate smoothly with responsive layouts, animations, and error boundary protections ensuring stability.
The desktop app builds successfully for Windows, macOS, and Linux with native installer generation and proper API communication.
